en.reason: Bloomberg reports Epic Games’ $1.5 billion Disney collaboration is pivoting to an AI-first model, with Anthropic’s Claude writing all code and guiding all art while humans manage generated content, and a Marvel/Star Wars shooter indefinitely delayed from March 2027.

sources.title_original: Anonymous organization-level registries for Dependabot
sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub 为 Dependabot 的组织级私有 registry 新增 Anonymous 认证，适合无需凭据即可访问的内部镜像；由于不能更改现有 registry 的认证方式，曾用占位 token 绕过的用户需删除后重建，该功能已在 github.com 全面可用，并将随 GitHub Enterprise Server 3.24 推出。

en.reason: GitHub added Anonymous authentication to Dependabot's organization-level private registries for credential-free internal mirrors; existing registries can't switch auth methods, so placeholder-token users must recreate them, and the feature is generally available on github.com and coming in GitHub Enterprise Server 3.24.

en.title: Burned through 500 billion Tokens in 3 months: AI "replicated" 83% of the Modern Warfare 2 source code
